1815. Role-Based Access System using Protected Inheritance

40

Medium

Role-Based Access System using Protected Inheritance

Problem Statement

Design a role-based access control system using protected inheritance.

Description
Base Class: User

Members:
Public
void login(string name)

Protected
int accessLevel
void displayAccessLevel()

Private
string password

Derived Class: Admin (protected inheritance)

Inherit User using protected derivation

Provide a public function:

void adminLogin(string name, int level)

Set access level

Call base class login

Display access level internally

Restrictions

login() must NOT be accessible from main() using Admin object.

displayAccessLevel() must not be directly accessible in main().

Demonstrate that protected inheritance converts public members into protected.

Input Format
Username
AccessLevel

Output Format

If accessLevel >= 5:

Admin Logged In
Access Level: <level>

Otherwise:

Insufficient Privileges
